behavioral_notes.observation: event_booth_sale makes a booth category sellable by linking it to a product.product (product_id, required, domain service_tracking='event_booth', default product_product_event_booth). price is a stored editable compute seeded from product_id.list_price + product_id.price_extra, so each category can override the shared product's price. price_incl runs product_id.taxes_id.compute_all to get the tax-included price; price_reduce / price_reduce_taxinc apply the contextual pricelist discount (product_id._get_contextual_discount, @api.depends_context(*PRICE_CONTEXT_KEYS)) tax-excl and tax-incl. A @api.constrains forces product_id.service_tracking=='event_booth'. event.type.booth re-exposes product_id/price/currency as related to its booth_category_id so event-type templates carry pricing. None of this pricing/tax/discount logic is visible in metadata.

Confirming a sale order is what actually books the booths. The overridden sale.order.action_confirm() first super()-confirms, then for every order line whose service_tracking=='event_booth' it raises a ValidationError unless event_booth_pending_ids is set ('configure before confirming'), then calls order_line._update_event_booths(). _update_event_booths re-checks each pending booth.is_available (raising if any went unavailable) then calls event_booth_registration_ids.sudo().action_confirm(). Registration.action_confirm gathers _get_fields_for_booth_confirmation (sale_order_line_id, partner_id, contact_name/email/phone) and calls the parent event.booth.action_confirm(values), flipping booth.state to 'unavailable' AND writing those sale/partner/contact values onto the booth; then _cancel_pending_registrations() message_posts a cancellation note and _action_cancel()s every rival sale order competing for the same booth and unlinks their registrations. This whole cross-model booking cascade is invisible to metadata.

event.booth.registration (One2many off both the SO line and the booth) lets several draft sale orders reserve the same physical booth at once; the booth is only truly taken at order confirmation, when the winner confirms and all rival registrations/orders are cancelled. Selecting booths on a line writes event_booth_pending_ids, whose inverse creates one event.booth.registration per selected booth (partner_id from order_id.partner_id) and unlinks de-selected ones; partner/contact fields default from the SO partner but stay editable. A unique(sale_order_line_id, event_booth_id) SQL constraint plus a constraint that all registrations on a line share one event guard consistency. This reservation-buffer pattern is pure code behavior.

behavioral_notes.element: event-booth product type + sale.order.line._get_display_price / catalog filtering
behavioral_notes.observation: A new service_tracking option 'event_booth' is added on product.template/product.product (selection_add, ondelete set default; onchange forces invoice_policy='order'; constraints block changing tracking off a product still bound to a booth category, and add it to _service_tracking_blacklist). sale.order.line._get_display_price overrides pricing: when a line has pending booths and an event it sums per-booth booth_category_id.price_reduce (or booth.price when discounts are hidden) and converts to the SO currency, so the line price comes from booth categories rather than the bare product. sale.order._get_product_catalog_domain excludes service_tracking='event_booth' products from the catalog (they are picked via the configurator instead). Booth selection is driven by the event.booth.configurator TransientModel wizard surfaced through the patched SaleOrderLineProductField.

When the customer invoice tied to a booth-selling sale order is paid, the overridden account.move._invoice_paid_hook() walks line_ids.sale_line_ids and calls _update_event_booths(set_paid=True), which calls event.booth.action_set_paid() (is_paid=True) on the confirmed booths. Booths also cannot be deleted once linked to a sale order (event.booth._unlink_except_linked_sale_order raises UserError). This payment->paid-flag side-effect and delete guard are not in metadata.

extract_frontend reports a thin backend-only JS footprint: 2 js files, 0 xml templates, 0 owl_components, one registry add (views:event_booth_configurator_form, the JS-backed form for the booth-picker wizard) and one patch (SaleOrderLineProductField.prototype, which intercepts selecting an event-booth product on a sale order line to open the booth configurator instead of a plain product). Asset bundle web.assets_backend only; no frontend/storefront bundle - the public exhibitor storefront lives in website_event_booth, not here.

extract_frontend reports no outbound integration surface: 0 http call sites, no sdk imports, no api keys, no endpoints. event_booth_sale introduces no external calls; pricing/tax/discount all run through Odoo's in-process product, pricelist and account engines inherited from event_sale/sale.

it_architecture.application: event_booth_sale (Events Booths Sales bridge; auto_install, bridging event_booth and event_sale/sale)
information_flows: side-effect: sale.order.action_confirm -> sale.order.line._update_event_booths -> event.booth.registration.action_confirm -> event.booth.action_confirm (state=unavailable, partner/contact set) + cancel rival registrations & orders
side-effect: sale.order.line.event_booth_pending_ids inverse -> create/unlink event.booth.registration per selected booth
compute: event.booth.category.price / price_incl / price_reduce from product_id.list_price + taxes + contextual pricelist discount
compute: sale.order.line._get_display_price summed from booth_category_id.price_reduce when booths pending
guard: event.booth._unlink_except_linked_sale_order blocks deleting booths linked to a sale order

capabilities: Price Booth Categories via a Sellable Product (product_id + price/_incl/_reduce)
Sell Event Booths through Quotations & Sales Orders
Configure Booth Selection on a Sale Order Line (event.booth.configurator wizard)
Book/Assign Booths on Order Confirmation (action_confirm -> booth unavailable)
Mark Booths Paid on Invoice Payment (is_paid)

value_streams: Quote-to-Booked-Booth: add event-booth product line -> configurator picks event + booth category + booths (pending registrations) -> confirm sale order -> winning booths flip to unavailable & get partner/contact, rival orders cancelled -> invoice paid -> booths marked paid
products: product.product / product.template with service_tracking='event_booth' (the sellable booth offering; default product_product_event_booth)
policies: 4 access rules (registration + configurator); no module-specific record rules or groups; field-level groups gate pricing (group_event_registration_desk) and sale links (group_sale_salesman)
product_id on booth category required and constrained to service_tracking='event_booth'; service_tracking cannot be changed off a product bound to a booth category
event-booth products force invoice_policy='order' and are excluded from the standard product catalog domain
booking is gated: action_confirm raises unless every event-booth line has pending booths configured, and re-checks availability before confirming
unique(sale_order_line_id, event_booth_id) registration constraint; all registrations on one line must share a single event
confirming the winning order cancels and unlinks all rival registrations/orders for the same booth; booths linked to a sale order cannot be deleted

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: event_booth_sale is the bridge that turns the event booth value-network (Stabell & Fjeldstad mediating-technology: a fixed capacity of stands matched to exhibitors) into a sellable offering wired to the sales chain. Its economic logic stays network/capacity-mediation - booths are reserved (event.booth.registration lets several bidders hold the same stand) and only allocated available->unavailable when an exhibitor wins on order confirmation, with rival orders auto-cancelled; that is matching of demand to limited shared capacity, not sequential transformation. The module bolts that network onto sale.order/sale.order.line, product pricing/tax/pricelist and account.move payment so the booking has a price, an invoice and a paid flag. It is a primary, customer-facing sell motion: pricing an offering, configuring it on a quotation, confirming the order and recognising payment. APQC 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services is the closest PCF home (event booth/sponsorship sales - quote, configure, confirm, get paid); the booth catalog/assignment base lives in event_booth and the public storefront in website_event_booth, while this bridge owns the paid sale + reservation/booking portion of that sell process.

standard_capabilities: make a booth category sellable by linking a service product and deriving price / tax-included / discounted prices
sell booths on standard quotations and sales orders via a booth configurator wizard on the order line
multi-bidder booth reservation (pending registrations) resolved at order confirmation
automatic booth booking (state unavailable + partner/contact) and rival-order cancellation on confirm
invoice the booth (invoice_policy=order) and flag booths paid when the invoice is paid
booth-count smart button and SO<->booth navigation
typical_fits: exhibitions/trade shows selling priced exhibitor stands per event through the sales team
sponsorship/booth packages quoted and invoiced like any other product
recurring events templating priced booths via event types
common_gaps: public/online booth checkout and exhibitor self-service registration (needs website_event_booth)
deposit/partial-payment or per-booth advance invoicing rules beyond invoice_policy=order
floor-plan / spatial stand picker and visual availability map
approval or waitlist workflow beyond the binary available/unavailable + first-confirmed-wins logic

open_questions: Whether partial/deposit payments (not full invoice payment) should still flip booths to is_paid, since _invoice_paid_hook fires on full payment.
How website_event_booth public selection interacts with the multi-bidder event.booth.registration reservation buffer (selection before or after partner assignment).
Whether multi-company scoping of booth sales is expected given the module adds no record rules (relies on inherited sale/event groups).
